title: Check if Grid Satisfies Conditions
summary: Given a 2D matrix of size m x n, verify that each cell equals the one directly below it and differs from the cell to its right.
statement: Given a 2D matrix of size m x n, verify that each cell equals the one directly below it and differs from the cell to its right. Return true if all cells meet these criteria, otherwise return false.
constraints: Every vertically adjacent pair in a column must be equal.
Every horizontally adjacent pair in a row must be different.
Return whether the entire rectangular grid satisfies both rules.
hints: Each rule concerns only immediate neighbors.
Scan every cell and compare downward and rightward when those neighbors exist.
Return false on the first violated equality or inequality.
Every adjacency is checked once, so passing all checks is equivalent to satisfying the grid conditions.
editorial: Every adjacency is checked once, so passing all checks is equivalent to satisfying the grid conditions.

tests.explanation: Columns are constant and every horizontal neighbor differs.
Horizontal neighbors match and columns differ, violating both rules.
